Class Core

The Core class maintains the system's active configuration as well as provides access to hardware.

Class Integrals

A class that can calculate and store integral information from a DataSet1D object. The configuration is stored in this class. The default is to do an automatic integral calculation.
Integrals.integralMode()
Returns the integralMode, see IntegralMode enum class.

Returns:

    IntegralMode
Integrals.setIntegralModeAutomatic()
The next time integrals are calculated, manual mode will be used.
Integrals.setIntegralModeManual()
The next time integrals are calculated, automatic mode will be used.
Integrals.integralThresholdMultiplier()
Get the integral threshold multiplier.

Returns:

    double The threshold multiplier
Integrals.setIntegralThresholdMultiplier(multiplier)
Set the integral threshold multiplier.

Parameters:

  • multiplier double The threshold multiplier
Integrals.integralThreshold()

Returns:

    double The threshold used when the integrals were last calculated
Integrals.integrate(dataSet, type)
Use the given dataset and current configuration to calculate integrals. The intergrals are stored in this object. If the TD SNR is higher than 2.0, the integral threshold is increased to try to ignore noise in the FD data. This is an overloaded function. The integrals can be computed on the real, imaginary, magnitude or power of an spectrum.

Parameters:

  • dataSet DataSet1D The dataset to use for integration
  • type string is a string possible values: real imag mag power
Integrals.integrate(dataSet)
Use the given dataset and current configuration to calculate integrals. The intergrals are stored in this object. If the TD SNR is higher than 2.0, the integral threshold is increased to try to ignore noise in the FD data. This is an overloaded function. The integrals will be computed on the real part of an spectrum.

Parameters:

  • dataSet DataSet1D The dataset to use for integration
Integrals.calculateMinMaxIntegralsPpm(dataSet, type)
Find left and right basins of each peak and return two vectors in ppm with the left and right values.

Parameters:

  • dataSet DataSet1D (input) The pointer to a DataSet1D object
  • type string (input) The type of data (real, imag, mag or power) to process

Returns:

  1. vector<_double_> minInt The left basin of each peak found
  2. vector<_double_> maxInt The right basin of each peak found
  3. vector<_double_> peak The peak in between basins
Integrals.addManualIntegral(integralStartPpm, integralEndPpm)
Add a manual integral using the specified start and end points.

Parameters:

  • integralStartPpm double The start value in PPM
  • integralEndPpm double The end value in PPM

Returns:

    int The integral id
Integrals.removeManualIntegral(integralId)
Remove a manual integral with the specified integral ID. Integrals with an ID higher than this will be adjusted by -1.

Parameters:

  • integralId unsigned_int The ID of the integral to remove.
Integrals.removeAllManualIntegrals()
Remove all manual integrals.
Integrals.setReferenceEnergy(referenceEnergy)
Set the reference energy for the currently selected integral mode. If you change the integral mode, you will need to re-set the reference energy.

Parameters:

  • referenceEnergy double When calculated, all integrals will be scaled so that this is considered a value of 1.0
Integrals.referenceEnergy()
Get the reference energy for the currently selected integral mode.

Returns:

    double The value that is considered 1.0 after scaling
Integrals.integralRange(id)
Get the range of an integral.

Parameters:

  • id unsigned_int The integral number (from 0 to numIntegrals() - 1)

Returns:

  1. double xStart The start value (in PPM)
  2. double xEnd The end value (in PPM)
Integrals.numIntegrals()
Get the number of integrals (automatic or manual, whichever is the current configuration)

    unsigned_int The number of integrals.
